$description: SOURCE OF TRUTH for stage 1, Branding. Hand-maintained; tokens.css is
generated from it by build-tokens.py and must never be edited directly.
Two tiers, which is the split this system previously lacked:
primitive - named for what it IS   (color.indigo.950, space.md)
semantic  - named for what it DOES (surface-base -> {color.indigo.950})
Authored in JSON rather than CSS so the same values can generate Swift and
Kotlin later. Neither reads CSS custom properties.
The raw material. A value appears here exactly once; every semantic token
referencing it points at the same entry, so changing a colour is one edit.
Ladder steps track lightness: lower is lighter. The spacing is uneven
because these values were designed one at a time rather than as a ramp -
that irregularity is real and is left visible rather than smoothed over.
The gold family is the Khaos Studio accent; the warm family is the app's
neutral ramp (D-005). See DECISIONS.md D-004/D-005.
#1d3fd6 is a blue, reached only by --st-provis-*.
The Khaos Studio accent. 400 is the brand value and carries the action
scale in both modes; the deeper rungs exist because #ffcc00 is 1.5:1 on
white and cannot be ink or an edge there. 700 gives the light-mode
button its boundary at 3.9:1, and 750 is the lightest gold that clears
4.5:1 as text on the light ground.
Four rungs, not six. A 50 tint and a 600 mid were drafted alongside
them and both landed unused - the style guide marked them so on the
first render. Adding an unreached primitive in the same change that
documents five orphaned greens would have been a poor joke.
status/normal only, since D-004 moved the action scale to gold. Rungs
600, 650, 800 and 950 were the primary button and its ink and now
have no consumer - they are proposed for retirement in D-004 rather
than deleted here, because this repo tags before it removes.
850 was on that list too. #218 re-valued it from #086b40 to #03623c
while it had no consumer and made it light-mode status/normal ink:
the shallowest green at the family hue (158.3) whose worst case, as
caption text on its own 12% wash over the light ground, clears 5:1.
#086b40 cleared 4.5:1 by 0.04 and was ruled too thin.
status/warning. Was `amber` until D-004, and moved from hue 41 to hue
28 to open a gap against the gold action scale at hue 48. That gap is
bought from the other side - warning to alarm narrows from 41 to 28.
The trade and its Reopen-if are recorded in DECISIONS.md D-004.
The app's neutral ramp since D-005 (the Quiet-Pro direction). Warm
pro-gray, never indigo and never achromatic: dark mode sits on a warm
near-black and light mode on a warm silver, so the two modes read as
one material rather than a cool grey beside an eggplant.
The spacing is uneven because the values were designed one at a time
(the catalog's Quiet-Pro override, docs/harvest-khaos-machine-tokens.md)
rather than as a ramp — that irregularity is real and left visible.
One near-duplicate is resolved here rather than carried as two rungs 2
apart: the light-mode tertiary #6f6d6a was unified into #716f6c, an
imperceptible step, because a value appears here exactly once. #171615
and #1c1b1a are kept separate as 950 / 900 because they are different
roles (the dark base vs the light primary text).
Three faces, and the rule is what each one is FOR:
display  titles and acts   headings, and the button that does the thing
sans     says everything else
mono     anything transcribed - a MAC, an SSID, a version, an ID
Display and sans are the Khaos Studio pair. Mono is not a brand face -
the studio site has no monospace - and stays JetBrains Mono, because the
transcription rule is about what the text IS, not about who it is for.
One object per style rather than four loose values. A type style is a
single thing on iOS and Android, and this is the shape that ports.
What each value is FOR. Mode-dependent: dark is the default (:root),
light is emitted under html[data-theme="light"].
The neutral surfaces, text and borders point at the `warm` family (the
Quiet-Pro pro-gray/silver direction, D-005).
action/* is gold in both modes - the brand accent IS the call to action on
khaos.studio, and green is spoken for by status/normal. The fill stays the
literal brand gold in light mode and takes gold.700 as its border, because
#ffcc00 on white is 1.5:1 and a fill that light needs an edge to exist.
The --st-* naming the tile-system document uses. Kept so that page still
renders. `alias` entries simply re-point at a real token; the rest are
five extra statuses the main scale never defined and that no component
currently draws. Delete once archive/khaotik-tile-system_12.html is retired.
Computed from other tokens rather than given a value, so it tracks the
neutral ramp in both modes instead of being pinned to a hex.
Note which tier each one references, because that decides whether it is
mode-aware - and note that naming the SEMANTIC tier is not enough on its
own. illustration-ink points at two semantic tokens and is now fully
mode-aware through BOTH: #75 repointed text-tertiary per theme, so the 45%
that used to be a fixed grey now moves with the mode as surface-base already
did. The tier violation D64 recorded is closed at the source rather than
worked around here, and the derivation is deliberately unchanged -- Andrew's
ruling is to revisit it when it gets its first consumer. scrim points at a
PRIMITIVE deliberately: a scrim darkens what is behind it in both modes,
and pointing it at surface-base would make it lighten in light mode - a
white veil over white content.
